absences: No microreactor news dated after 2026-10-30 surfaced in any search (about 24 searches). Newest hits were the shipped 2026-10-27 to 2026-10-30 items. The search index appears not to carry November 2026 coverage for this market.

WNN 2026-11-05 Helen Helsinki SMR environmental assessment (large SMR, not fetched). WNN 2026-10-30 Doosan upper reactor vessel for NuScale (77 MWe module class, not fetched).

Oklo Q3 2026 results (about 2026-11-06) show Aurora first-powerhouse startup moved to 2028-2029. Aurora is about 75 MWe, outside the 1-20 MW scope, so not written up. Source is secondary (MarketBeat/Earnings Whispers transcript coverage); the SEC 10-Q is the primary.

Radiant Kaleidos criticality at INL DOME: the 2026-07-04 target passed with no criticality report found. The 2026-10-29 DSA approval is already shipped. Readiness review status and a start date remain undisclosed as of the newest coverage.
Aalo-X criticality status after March 2026: not found. The July 4, 2026 DOE pilot goal outcome for Aalo is unverified.
Last Energy PWR-5 criticality: not reached as of a September 2026 local report, which said final DOE authorization was expected within months. Post-September status not found.
Natura MSR-1 operation or criticality: not confirmed after the 2026-09-22 DOE salt delivery (already shipped).
Terrestrial TETRA initial criticality target of July 2026 is unverified; no post-January 2026 primary update found.
NuCube-Launch Two SPAC: no shareholder vote result or closing found. The S-4 meeting date was blank in the filing reviewed.
NANO Nuclear: a Fortil KRONOS fuel-handling milestone appeared in an undated German feed; no primary release found, so not written up. The IMPSA engineering agreement (2026-10-21) is already shipped.
Radiant TRISO fuel delivery to INL DOME (WNN, 2026-07-03, verified in fetch) predates the 60-day gap window and is not in skip/news.json. Not written up because it is outside the window.
NRC acceptance of the UIUC KRONOS construction permit application (acceptance letter dated 2026-05-18, company release about 2026-05-20). Outside the window; not in skip, noted only.
ANS Nuclear Newswire RSS was 404 and NRC and Radiant newsrooms return 403 to non-browser clients, so primary company pages were not read for November 2026.
